name: Analog Delay
description: Bucket-brigade delay: dark, soft, slightly noisy repeats that dull as the time gets longer, with chorus on the echoes and a stepped clock that makes them jump by musical intervals.

params.name: Time
params.description: The gap between repeats. It sets the clock of the delay line, so longer times are darker and grainier, and moving it bends the pitch of the echoes already in the line.

params.name: Feedback
params.description: How much of each echo goes round again. Near the top the repeats stop dying away and build into a soft, saturated drone.

params.name: Mod Depth
params.description: How far the clock wobbles. A little gives the repeats a chorus shimmer, a lot gives a seasick vibrato.

params.name: Mod Rate
params.description: Speed of the clock wobble, from a slow drift to a fast warble.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Brightness of the echoes. Each repeat passes the filters again and comes back duller. At long times the clock holds the top end down whatever this is set to.

params.name: Age
params.description: Wear on the circuit. Higher settings add hiss that breathes with the signal, earlier saturation, a faint clock whine at long times and a looser, pumping response.

params.name: Interval A
params.description: The first clock step. The echoes in the line jump by this interval when the step arrives and jump back by it when the clock returns.

params.name: Interval B
params.description: The second clock step, taken after the clock has returned from the first. Off repeats Interval A alone.

params.name: Step
params.description: How many repeats pass between clock steps. Short steps give a busy sequence of jumping echoes, long ones an occasional lurch.

params.name: Glide
params.description: How slowly the clock moves to each step. At zero the echoes jump cleanly by the interval, higher up they slide like a tape being slowed by hand.

params.name: Spread
params.description: Stereo width of the echoes. The left and right lines drift and wobble apart, so the repeats widen and move while the dry signal stays put.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the echoes.

origin.note: Written for live-mix on cpp/kit. Models a companded bucket-brigade delay in outline, not any one unit.
